title: Synapse
tagline: Teach a little cell. Watch its brain learn.
pitch: A cute glowing cell lives in a pond, and its brain, a real neural network, is always on screen beside it. Shine a light signal, watch what the cell does, then give a treat or poison. You see the threads in its brain strengthen as it learns what each signal means.
what_you_get: A cute, expressive glowing cell in a bioluminescent pond
Its real neural network always visible, with threads that thicken as it learns
Eight light signals to teach, one at a time, with the goal shown as a picture
Left-click for a treat, right-click for poison, with a hint line that says what to do next
A test after each signal with learning switched off, compared with the cell before training
complexity_reason: A real learning network, a procedurally animated puppy with ten moves, animated hand signals, a training cycle with reward windows, eight lessons with frozen tests, tamagotchi needs, a brain view, saves and phone support.
core_loop: Shine a signal, watch the cell hold one move for about three seconds, then give a treat if it was the right move or poison if not; its brain strengthens or weakens that link.
player_goal: Teach the puppy each hand signal so that it does the right move at least 4 times in 5 show-time tries, with as few lessons as possible for three stars.

controls.desktop: Keys 1-8 or the signal buttons shine a signal. Left-click the pond or G gives a treat, right-click or B gives poison. T test, F speed, Esc pause.
controls.touch: Signal buttons, TREAT and POISON buttons, tap the pond for a treat, long press for poison.

scheme.does: Shine a light signal in the pond.
Reward what the cell just did.
Tell the cell that was wrong.
Start the test with learning switched off.
Pause, sound, full screen, start over.

entities.name: Cell
entities.behaviour: Born with ten moves: float, shrink, sleep, spin, hop, come to you, glow, go left, go right, wander. After a signal it looks at the light, then its brain picks one move which it holds about three seconds, then rests while a reward window stays open.
entities.look: A translucent teal blob with a wobbling membrane, big shiny eyes, rosy cheeks, a little mouth, a nucleus and waving tails.

entities.name: Signal
entities.behaviour: A glowing symbol shines at the top of the pond for about two and a half seconds and tints the water.
entities.look: Eight coloured symbols: sun, triangle, square, moon, spiral, up, left, right.

entities.name: Treat and poison
entities.behaviour: Left-click sends gold nutrient to the cell (+1.2), right-click sends red poison (-0.7).
entities.look: Gold and red glowing drops that fly to the cell.

mechanics.name: Real learning
mechanics.detail: A neural network with 9 signal inputs, 27 hidden neurons (three tuned to each signal) and 10 move outputs, trained by backpropagation with an advantage actor-critic; clicker +1, treat +1.6, no -0.7.

mechanics.name: Training cycle
mechanics.detail: Signal, the cell looks at it, one move held 3 s, 2.2 s rest; treat or poison in that window counts for that move.

mechanics.name: Show time
mechanics.detail: Eight tries (five of the new signal, three review) with learning off; pass needs 4 of 5 and 2 of 3.

progression: Eight signals unlock one at a time: sun (glow), triangle (come), square (shrink), moon (sleep), spiral (spin), up (hop), left, right. Stars from tries needed: 3 under 30, 2 under 60.
win_lose: No losing. Pass show time for stars; finishing all eight completes the game.

art.style: Bioluminescent microscope: soft glows and fine glowing lines on deep blue-violet.
art.background: Dark gradient with drifting motes and faint out-of-focus membranes.

presentation.title_screen: A glowing neural web forming itself, the cell saying hello, the name SYNAPSE and a BEGIN button, with three numbered steps.
presentation.hud: Top: signal medallions with stars and the goal as a picture. Left: the brain. Right: the pond and a learning graph. Bottom: signal buttons, treat, poison, speed, test, menu.
presentation.typography: system-ui, light weight, wide letter spacing.
presentation.buttons: Capsule outlines of light that pulse to show what to press next.
presentation.end_screen: Before and now tick marks per try, with stars.

juice: The pond is tinted by the signal colour
Treat and poison drops fly to the cell
The brain flashes gold or red and a wave runs back through it
Light pulses travel along the active path
A graph climbs as it learns
build_notes: Moves are innate; the network chooses which move each signal means. Verified headless: 16 of 16 brains learn all eight signals.
